about: Image effects by id (PR 10a, docs/OO-MIGRATION.md section 3). Art: Game Art & Motion PR10a effects v1 + v2 additions (screen_burst, glow_pale, glow_yellow) + v3 subtle redo (impact rings, chain bolt, arc flash, overdrive aura, tower aura t0-t4 in <effect>/v3/), Nov 16 2026 (PROVENANCE.json, LICENSE.md). sheets: sheet id -> art JSON next to this file (flat FX sheet: frameW, frameH, count, fps, loop, anchor, image; grid sheets add rows x cols, one strip per row r0, r1, ...). effects: id -> settings read by the generic SpriteEffect (src/fx/SpriteEffect.js): sheet (or a list picked by variant), strip (or a list picked by pick), fit (radius | segment | stretch: segment with height = size x base | fill: stretched over the caller's x, y, w, h), frame (a fixed frame of the strip), size and alpha (a number or {from,to,by:level|progress,ease}), pulse / alphaPulse {amp,speed}, fade {power,gain,until}, offset [x,y], blend (canvas composite op), skipLow, on (EVENTS key: play at the event's x,y). Radius fit: size x the caller's base is drawn as half the frame width. impacts: ImpactSync impact name -> its ring / bloom effect ids, burst (count, speedMul), colors (particle variant names), radius (ring), bloomAlpha, flash, shake, thump, sfx, throttle. presets: emitter and drawer settings (streakBurst, aura, trail, glow, ring). themes: per art style blend, glow strength, trail opacity. Particles, trails and glows name variants, never colours: a particle of variant v draws glow.v / mote.v / streak.v, a shot trail.v (PR 10b). Add an effect: add its entry and art files here; no code edit (sw.js precaches what this file lists).

overdriveAura.what: Overdrive heat ring around the tower while Overdrive runs (was OverdriveRing: an orange disc pulsing to 1.65-2.15 x tower radius). The art's flames end near the frame edge, so the frame's half-width is 2.25 x radius: the flames reach past the tower sprite as far as the old disc did

towerAura.what: Ground glow under the tower, one sheet per aura tier, bigger and stronger with tower power (was TowerGroundGlow; sizes matched to its glow by alpha-mass radius)

chainBolt.what: Chain Spark bolt stretched along each hop; row = one of 3 jagged variants, columns = fresh / mid / fade (was ChainArcs strokes). v3 art (4 px soft core, no dark underlay) drawn at 0.8: about 8 px visible line with a 3 px core, main's 7.5 px stroke weight

chainArcFlash.what: Light spark ring on each struck enemy for the first 55% of the bolt's life (was the white ChainArcs rings, radius 10 to 22); v3 art, last ring near radius 22

chainNodeGlow.what: Soft glow under each bolt node, radius 24 like the old one; skipped in low quality

impactFlash.what: Short amber screen burst on big world impacts (Decision 12; was ImpactFlashes' pale glow): centred on the impact in screen px, half the frame = half the screen's long side (the old flash's size; the art's alpha-mass radius 0.41 matches the old glow's 0.43), opacity = the impact's flash strength x (1 - life)^2 like the old flash
